 KTAB Abilene Follow BIG COUNTRY STORM TEAM: storm chances increase this evening
 Susana Harbert Mon, November 2, 2026 at 4:53 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Monday, November 1st, 2026
 STORM PREDICTION CENTER 
 TORNADO THREAT
 HAIL THREAT
 WIND THREAT
 STORM POTENTIAL OUTLOOK
 The storm prediction center has placed portions of the region under a marginal (1/5) to slight (2/5) risk for severe weather. This means we can expect to see isolated to scattered severe storms in the area. The biggest concern with these storms will be for damaging winds and large hail, while the threat is low, we could also see a few tornadoes with a chance that one of them is on the stronger side (highest risk for those in Knox, Haskell, Throckmorton, Shackelford and Stephens counties). The flood threat does remain marginal and isolated to the southeast (1/4) risk.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement TIMELINE :
 Models look to be in agreement with a general time frame of storms bubbling up closer to 5 pm across our central counties before increasing in size (vertically) and expanding out east. As they do so, they will form a line of storms mostly in our backyard as the starting point for storms thanks to a dry-line and cold front. BUT and this is important; cloud cover today could be make or break for storm development. This morning cloud cover is keeping a tight lid on the atmosphere, IF we can find some clearing then we will have some of the ingredients necessary for storms to occur. The cold front pushes in behind leaving us with a mostly seasonal, sunny yet breezy day for election day.
 SAFETY: 
 Here's a breakdown of 3 different categories we see for a severe thunderstorm alert. Baseline which represents your typical severe thunderstorm warning (we could see a few of these today). Rarer, but still a small chance of this warning being emitted today is the considerable threat with the potential for 70mph+ destructive winds or golf ball sized hail. Lastly a destructive tag severe thunderstorm warning which will trigger a WEA (wireless emergency alert) to make sure folks are weather aware.
 SOCIAL: To be in the know about severe storms in your area, make sure to download the BCH-To-Go mobile app for the latest details as these storms develop throughout the day.
